label: AQS-ZW Series
description: Z-Wave Air Quality Sensor with PM2.5, temperature, humidity, illuminance, and CO2 (optional) monitoring

paramInformation.label: RGB Light Color
paramInformation.description: Sets the RGB light color for the device.

paramInformation.label: PM2.5 Reporting Threshold
paramInformation.description: Sets the reporting threshold for PM2.5 levels in μg/m3.

paramInformation.label: Temperature Reporting Threshold
paramInformation.description: Sets the reporting threshold for temperature changes in °C.

paramInformation.label: Humidity Reporting Threshold
paramInformation.description: Sets the reporting threshold for humidity changes in percentage.

paramInformation.label: CO2 Reporting Threshold
paramInformation.description: Sets the reporting threshold for CO2 concentration changes in ppm.

commandClasses.name: Multilevel Sensor
commandClasses.description: Supports PM2.5, temperature, humidity, CO2, and illuminance monitoring

commandClasses.name: Notification
commandClasses.description: Reports air quality status and power events

PM2.5.reportingInterval: 30 minutes or upon change of +/- 6 μg/m3

CO2.reportingInterval: 30 minutes or upon change of +/- 100 ppm (AQS-3 model only)

RGB Light.settings: Adjustable via Z-Wave or local button

metadata.inclusion:
1. Plug in the AC Power adapter, connect to the DC Jack on the Air Quality Sensor to power up.
2. Put the Z-Wave Gateway or Control Panel into inclusion mode (please refer to the Z-Wave Gateway or Control Panel manual).
3. Within 1 second, press the Function Button 3 times.
metadata.exclusion:
The Air Quality Sensor must be removed from existing Z-Wave network before being included into another. 
1. Put the Z-Wave gateway or control panel into Exclusion mode (please refer to the Z-Wave gateway or control panel manual).
2. Within 1 second, press the Function Button 3 times and the device will be removed from the Z-Wave network.
metadata.reset:
(Only use factory reset when network Control Panel/Gateway is missing or inoperable).
Press and hold the Function Button for 10 seconds to perform factory reset.
